full_page.content:
c. 1919, August
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 3.
Retreat Aug. 18' 19. Fr. Capistran
Pg. 1b. 1st. Con 18th. P.M. Retreat -
Special exercises and Effort to imitate - follow Jesus into Garden.
19th.
"Save thy soul" Object of retreat - 5 A.M. 2nd. Obedience
"My meat is to do the will of Him - 3rd. Obedience (a) better than sacrifice
(b) Shortest surest way of victory over our 3 enemies. Disobedience, still the monster that turns Paradise (Religious state -- S. Bernard) into hell. e.g. I. first Parents II. Soul Almost any restless dissatisfied Religious III.
4th. Death -
certain; & Uncertain? e.g. Br. Seraphim, Sol., Pius, Albert Joseph etc.
20th.
1st. Confession (i.e. 4:50 A.M.
2nd. Poverty in general, "If thou wilt be perfect go follow me.
3rd. Poverty (a) Vow of. (b) Virtue of. (10:45 A.M.
4th. P.M. Chastity ... of which really "Angel tongues alone should speak - so delicate and so gentle. See Apoc XIV-4
5th. Judgement Day. 7:30
(a) Immediately before.
during. c) after
